table.note: no table: no column was matched to a sample; agent: Each tar member is a Drop-seq digital expression matrix with genes in rows and 400 single-cell barcodes in columns. The values are small whole numbers, mostly 0, 1, 2 and so on, so they are raw UMI counts. No sample is given in sources because every sample's counts are spread over 400 per-cell columns, and no single column holds the counts of a whole sample.
